The '''Herrik system''' was a remote [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Herrik]] and a [[Herrik's sun|star]]. The [[Star/Legends|star]] emitted a unique form of stellar interference that caused numerous equipment failures and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] malfunctions among a research team in the system.<ref name="TOR" />
